signOffConditionVerdicts.note: Three of the four classes carry exactly one threshold each. Configuration carries none and is recorded as an explicit exception rather than left out: a value arriving on change cannot be judged by elapsed time, so any number would stale a correct value. Four classes are named and no class carries two.

The three-outcome evaluation and the latched STALE verdict are preserved and relied on rather than merely allowed. Configuration resolves to ObservedFreshnessUnevaluated by design, which is the outcome that exists so an unevaluated class is distinguishable from a fresh one instead of being read as lenient.

guardPermissions.reason: Thresholds now exist for three classes, so the guard stops being the only outcome the station can reach for them. It remains the recorded outcome for Configuration, which carries an explicit exception, and for any class DG-TLM names that this record has not budgeted - which requirement 8 criterion 5 settles by amendment rather than by reopening the Gate.

entries.value: No threshold. Capability, parameters and identity arrive on change or on request rather than periodically, so elapsed time cannot judge them: an unchanged value is valid, not stale. The class resolves to ObservedFreshnessUnevaluated, which is the third outcome the evaluation exists to provide. A number here would have been invented and would stale a correct value.
